name: coupa-import-delta
summary: Coupa endpoint -> MDH dataset as a Rossum-hosted import job (CIB 2.0 template 55; same settings run on the CIB 1.x webhook): upsert by id, order by id, incremental on updated-at - for project-specific slices CIB does not ship.

coupa_base_url.description: Coupa tenant URL with trailing slash, e.g. https://<tenant>.coupacloud.com/

client_id.description: Coupa OAuth client id (the secret goes in hook secrets as client_secret, never here)

client_scope.description: OAuth scope the endpoint needs, e.g. core.common.read

endpoint.description: Coupa API path without leading slash, e.g. api/lookup_values

dataset_name.description: target MDH dataset / Data Storage collection

delta_from.description: lower bound of updated-at; a fixed ISO timestamp after a bulk load or to recover from a failure loop, then back to ${last_modified_date}

records_per_request.description: page size; 50 is the maximum the job accepts

max_run_time_s.description: job run limit (60-36000); a run stopped at the limit counts as failed

provenance: Generalized from the CIB 2.0 baseline's 12 Coupa master-data import jobs (template 55; all use method update, id_keys [id], order_by id, updated-at[gt_or_eq] ${last_modified_date}) and from a live job-hook test on 2026-10-08 that imported a 234-record Coupa endpoint in 5 pages of 50 into a fresh dataset. Filter vocabulary from a production CIB 1.x project's slice hooks (2026-10). The filled fragment has not yet run as a slice import - hence candidate.
notes: Replace the literal fields list with what matching needs; keep id, the status field and updated_at. order_by must stay unique (id): the import pages by offset, and a non-unique key (created_at) duplicates and drops records on ties. Never add dir: desc (the 1.x service hangs). Do not put a status filter on this incremental import unless records cannot leave the set - see coupa-baseline-reference#status-filters-on-incremental-imports.
